loci.location: First display: operator after the second equals
loci.evidence: In half a, the final tall t stroke is followed directly by the opening parenthesis. Its short terminal flick remains part of the letter; a separate abbreviation stop was not visible. The accent over é and the complete numérot run were checked.

A closed-looking loop survives on both sides of the darker upright of the live 1. This supports a doubtful underlying 0, with the overlay order retained. The crop does not settle the earlier digit completely.
